title: 亚洲贡献全球六成增长：多市场齐头并进，高盛亚太总裁怎么看？
speaker: Kevin Sneader

segments.en: the world I want Goldman Sachs to do well globally if that means the Asia is going to play its part drive a little bit more of the growth well that maybe has to be expected this is the growth region
segments.zh: 我希望高盛在全球表现出色，亚洲也要发挥其作用，推动更多增长，这是增长区域，或许应有更多期待。

segments.en: as you well know the numbers are out there 60% of global growth happens here so we should expect a little more from Asia and I hope that will continue and just more granularity across geographies
segments.zh: 如你所知，数据显示全球60%的增长发生在这里，因此我们对亚洲应有更多期待，希望这一趋势持续，并在各区域更加细化。

segments.en: is anything stand out to you as a really fast growing part of the franchise here and I love all my children equally and this has been this has been the moment that we're in and then the one-out performs the end well the reality is we've had a moment in time when look at the strength in Japan look at the strength in Korea look at the strength in China look at the strength in Taiwan
segments.zh: 有没有哪个业务板块增长特别快？我对所有业务一视同仁，但现实是，我们看到日本、韩国、中国内地、中国台湾等市场都表现强劲。

segments.en: so this is long and I think it's hard to say that any one of those is going to take a different growth path at this moment in time they're all well set and that's why I think when I look at the region as a whole it is a moment when you really do have most geographies operating at higher levels of performance
segments.zh: 所以很难说哪个市场会走上不同的增长路径，目前它们都准备充分。因此，从整个区域来看，大多数市场都处于较高水平的表现。

segments.en: and places like Australia where to be in a little bit sluggish actually on the M&A front it's now setting the pace so things can change too
segments.zh: 像澳大利亚，之前并购方面有些迟缓，现在却开始领跑，所以情况也会变化。
